name: 21190-audiotranscribe-whisperlargev3-1gpu
model: openai/whisper-large-v3, fp16. Public and ungated, ~3 GiB, 1.55 B parameters.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of an a3 node. Adequate rather than required: the checkpoint would fit on a much smaller card.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 500 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 450 requests are measured.
workload: 511 real earnings-call audio clips from D4nt3/esb-datasets-earnings22-validation-tiny-filtered (split `validation`), one clip per request to POST /v1/audio/transcriptions. 500 of the 511 rows are used, so no clip is transcribed twice. Every clip is under 30 s. One turn, and nothing is sent beyond the file and the model name: the endpoint defaults to English transcription with a JSON reply.
purpose: A speech-to-text service transcribing short English earnings-call clips to JSON, one upload at a time on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat `key: value` only -- the parser DROPS nested blocks, so a
# dropped block would mean the engine runs without something this file declares. Environment
# variables cannot live here. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing.

model-path: openai/whisper-large-v3

tp-size: 1

# NO PREFIX REUSE: every request is a different audio clip, and the only thing two requests share
# is the four fixed special tokens the decoder always starts from.
disable-radix-cache: true
